thread:
slo-radar-bot: SLO alert p99 latency spike for hosted-infer-gateway in eu-west-1. 5m SLO burn 22% :warning: incident_id=inc_8012345678
sre-oncall-alex: acknowledged. digging. any customer escalations?
olivia-prod-support: Customer ACME reported increased 502s and timeouts since ~09:12 UTC. Opening support ticket 5542. They see auth failures intermittently.
ben-observability: Looking at dashboards — request rate steady, but p99 tails spiking. Traces sparse; sampling looks off. Suspect trace propagation broken at ingress layer.
sre-oncall-alex: Can you run query for 5xx by upstream and auth status? start with logs:
```
# logs: count by upstream, status, auth_error
select count(*) from request_logs
where service='hosted-infer-gateway' and timestamp>now()-10m
group by upstream, status, auth_error
```
ben-observability: Ran quick aggregation — big chunk of 502s from upstream 'kv-cache' and ~18% of those have 'auth:missing' tag. Sending snapshot: https://dash.redwood/xyz
devops-jen: Noted recent deploy to kv-cache at 09:05. Reverting?
sre-oncall-alex: Hold on. If auth_missing on 502s, could be a token propagation issue between proxy and authz service. Need traces to confirm. Ben, can you pull traces for a 502 sample request id=cf2a9...
ben-observability: Trace cf2a9... shows ingress -> proxy -> authz timed out -> proxy returned 502. But there's a tracing gap: authz spans missing for ~30% of samples.
olivia-prod-support: Customer says errors happen during long requests (chat generation), but also short ones. They sent an example request id cf2a9...
sre-oncall-alex: Steps: 1) enable increased trace sampling for hosted-infer-gateway for 15m; 2) run synthetic repro against kv-cache auth route with header rotation; 3) check edge keepalive metrics.
devops-jen: Increasing trace sampling now.
sre-oncall-alex: Quick repro cmd:
curl -v -H \"Authorization: Bearer <rotated-token>\" -X POST https://hosted-infer/api/v1/generate -d '{"input":"hello"}' -H 'x-client-id: acme'
Try in loop and inspect upstream: `for i in $(seq 1 20); do ...; done`
ben-observability: After sampling up, traces show authz spike of 504s at 09:11-09:18 and proxy had connection resets to kv-cache. Hypothesis: kv-cache nodes overloaded after deploy leading to auth handshake failures and token headers being dropped -> 502s.
sre-oncall-alex: Action items: pin kv-cache to previous deploy (devops-jen), rollback if necessary; set temporary routing to prefer healthy pool; notify CS; enable detailed ingress logs for 30m.
devops-jen: Rolling back kv-cache in eu-west-1 now. ETA ~6m.
customer-success-matt: Notifying ACME support ticket and offering mitigation steps (retry headers, increase timeout).
olivia-prod-support: ACME confirms errors reduced after rollback. Will keep monitoring. Any followups for postmortem?
sre-oncall-alex: Collect logs, attach traces, add dashboard panel for auth_missing fraction, create runbook entry for kv-cache deploy guardrails.
slo-radar-bot: SLO status recovering. p99 back to baseline.
ben-observability: Saving queries used:
- logs query shown above
- trace search: service:authz AND error:504 AND timestamp>now()-30m
- nginx keepalive stats: `nginx_upstream_handshake_failed_total{job="ingress"}`
olivia-prod-support: Thanks team. Closing support escalation if no regressions by EOD. :thumbsup:
